description: The only capability the WebView holds, and it is deliberately empty. A command the application itself registers is not gated by the ACL while the app declares no permission manifest of its own, so `core_version` and every later core command reach the WebView without anything being granted here. This list is therefore the set of TAURI-provided commands the frontend may call, and nothing yet needs one. Each entry added is a widening that AGENTS.md section 5 requires the pull request to state. `core:default` in particular is not that entry: it is Tauri's aggregate of every core plugin default, which would grant absolute-path resolution, event listen and emit, and the whole menu and tray command set at once — and would leave `core:image`'s from_path inert only for as long as the image-png and image-ico Cargo features stay off, so that setting a PNG tray icon would turn it into an unscoped file read without this file changing.
